source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In accepted CrossFolderNavigation, about:3pane waits for allMessagesLoaded. The standalone about:message branch closes the old wrapper, opens the destination, installs a TreeSelection and invokes the callback directly. Preserve these different setup boundaries when changing navigation. The direct callback is not evidence that every asynchronous folder/server condition is complete, and no standalone navigation was exercised.
title: Keep standalone message navigation on its separate view setup path
